topic: Deal Sheet: Rowan Digital Infrastructure — $1.5B нового финансирования под пайплайн 5.5 GW

sources.title: Rowan Digital Infrastructure secures US$ 1.5 billion in additional financing
facts: Rowan Digital Infrastructure secured over US$1.5 billion in additional financing
Term loan expanded by US$600 million, raising the Apterra facility from US$300 million to US$900 million
New revolving credit facility of US$590 million
New letter of credit facility of US$355 million
The revolver can grow to US$2 billion and the letter of credit facility to US$1 billion, subject to conditions
Term loan expansion led by Apterra Infrastructure Capital; revolver and letter of credit led by Citibank, with Mizuho, MUFG, Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Societe Generale, SMBC and Huntington
Purpose: early-stage development (land acquisition, power procurement, long-lead equipment orders), liquidity, and collateral such as utility interconnection deposits
5.5 GW US data center pipeline; more than 1.2 GW already contracted to technology companies
More than US$8 billion raised from over 40 lenders in the past 18 months
Original Apterra facility set up in September 2025
World: 606 projects, 51832 MW under construction, 37205 MW announced (published capacity only)
United States: 183 projects, 34287 MW under construction, 15943 MW announced

slides.text: Debt is arriving before the buildings: land, power and equipment are now financed first.

caption:
$1.5B: Rowan Digital Infrastructure's new financing, raised before most of its capacity is built.

A $600 million term loan expansion takes the Apterra facility from $300 million to $900 million. A new $590 million revolver and a $355 million letter of credit line were led by Citibank. Funds go to land, power procurement, long-lead equipment and interconnection deposits.

Rowan reports a 5.5 GW US pipeline, with more than 1.2 GW contracted. Our tracker lists 34287 MW under construction across 183 US projects.

Data: Coloprice pipeline tracker, 13 Nov 2026. Sources: W.Media.
